scenarios.title: POST /inward → service validates → repo persists header+lines → domain.apply_inward writes ledger rows
flow: Router (T-052) receives InwardCreate
InwardService.save_inward (T-047) validates date bounds + supplier/staff active + active grade-pair
InwardHeaderRepository.create_with_lines (T-043) persists header + lines
domain.stock.apply_inward (T-045) per line: SELECT FOR UPDATE → insert ledger row with delta=+nos
session.commit (atomic AC-027)
scenarios.exit_assertion: POST returns 201; 1 InwardHeader + 2 InwardLine + 2 StockLedger rows exist; place='Mallur'; running_balance per (design, grade): grade 1 = 10, grade OB = 5

scenarios.title: POST /sales after inward → ledger decreases by nos with Δ=-nos
flow: Seed: POST /inward establishes running_balance (design=D, grade=G) = 50
POST /api/v1/sales with nos=12 for same (D, G)
SalesService.save_sale (T-048) validates dealer + 2 staff + active pair
SalesHeaderRepository.create_with_lines (T-043) persists header + lines
domain.stock.apply_sale (T-045) writes ledger row with delta=-12
Final running_balance = 38; source_type='sale'
scenarios.exit_assertion: POST /sales returns 201; latest ledger row for (D, G) has delta=-12, running_balance=38, source_type='sale'; 2 ledger rows total (1 inward + 1 sale)

scenarios.title: GET /designs/{id}/grades-with-cb → POST /adjustments → ledger reflects signed difference
flow: Seed: inward establishes balance (D, G1)=100, (D, G2)=50
GET /designs/{D}/grades-with-cb?stock_date=today returns [{G1, code='1', software_cb=100}, {G2, code='OB', software_cb=50}]
AdjustmentService.save_adjustment (T-049) snapshots software_cb at save and computes difference
POST /adjustments with physical_cb={G1: 95, G2: 50} → difference={G1: -5, G2: 0}
domain.stock.apply_adjustment (T-045) writes ledger row with delta=-5 for G1 (zero-difference for G2 skipped per T-049 design)
adjustment_line audit rows persist for BOTH grades regardless of zero-difference
scenarios.exit_assertion: GET returns 200 with 2 rows + correct software_cb; POST /adjustments returns 201; 2 adjustment_line rows persisted (audit); ledger has 3 rows: 2 inward + 1 adjustment (delta=-5 for G1 only; G2 zero-diff skipped); final running_balance (D, G1)=95, (D, G2)=50

scenarios.title: Back-dated inward triggers domain._recompute_forward across all later ledger rows (DS-003 R-003)
flow: Seed forward: apply_inward(date=2026-06-22, nos=30) → ledger row A (running=30)
apply_inward(date=2026-06-25, nos=20) → ledger row B (running=50)
Back-date: apply_inward(date=2026-06-20, nos=5) → ledger row C inserted at txn_date=Jun 20
domain.stock._recompute_forward(from=Jun 20) re-reads rows_after(Jun 20) ASC and rewrites running_balance
Final balances (cumulative replay from prior_balance=0): C=5, A=35, B=55
scenarios.exit_assertion: 3 ledger rows for (D, G) ordered ASC by (txn_date, ledger_id) have running_balance=[5, 35, 55]

execution_results.output: POST /api/v1/inward returned 201; place='Mallur' (DS-013 snapshot verified); 1 InwardHeader + 2 InwardLine + 2 StockLedger rows; running_balance grade 1 = 10, grade OB = 5

GET /grades-with-cb returned 200 with [{1:100},{OB:50}]; POST /adjustments returned 201; 2 adjustment_line audit rows persisted; ledger has 3 rows (2 inward + 1 adjustment Δ=-5 for G1; G2 zero-diff skipped); final balances G1=95, G2=50

Forward [+30 Jun22, +20 Jun25] then back-date [+5 Jun20] triggered _recompute_forward; final balances ASC by (txn_date, ledger_id) = [5, 35, 55]; deltas preserved [5, 30, 20]; HLD R-003 mitigation verified end-to-end
